chunks: Whatever was in it from Ibrāhīm ibn Abī Ziyād al-Karkhī, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ibrāhīm ibn Abī Ziyād al-Karkhī.

key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ الْكَرْخ: The narrator whose transmission route is being specified.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a formal expression of narration in hadith transmission.
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: From my father; indicates the immediate transmitter in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ: A transmitter in the sanad/isnad through whom the report is narrated.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from Ibrāhīm ibn Abī Ziyād al-Karkhī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the compiler transmits reports from Ibrāhīm ibn Abī Ziyād al-Karkhī. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission, which is essential in hadith scholarship for identifying the route of narration.
